optimizer_runtime.existing_history_validation: no recursive prior-entry revalidation per transition
optimizer_runtime.history_consumer_audit: ExpertNonCombatDriver reads current location, visible boss and persistent resources; it does not read history; MAP/REWARDS keep exact history conservatively
optimizer_runtime.intermediate_history: full detached history only on MAP/REWARDS decision contexts; empty intermediate/post contexts otherwise
optimizer_runtime.new_entry_validation: pinned sanitizer and schema/version/index check once before append
optimizer_runtime.projection_cache: one consecutive post-transition to next-decision reuse keyed by exact adapter and snapshot object identity; disabled when a before-decision transform is installed
optimizer_runtime.semantics: native action selection, candidate order, Search-v2@400, Expert seeds, checkpoint restores and terminal utility unchanged
optimizer_runtime.terminal_history: full detached history materialized once after each controlled run
